strategic_objective: Deliver a usable, governed Work Engine by composing demonstrated root behavior with existing Rust semantic owners, preserving authority and truthful evidence while testing inference economics.
current_rationale: The root workflow demonstrates useful model-directed operation and the Rust domains contain substantial reusable execution/state mechanisms. Their composition and realized capability boundaries remain incomplete. New pilot and lifecycle qualification evidence supports a bounded, capability-qualified integration route. No causal net savings or full replacement is established. The dated reconciliation records the cutoff, source standing and exact proposed route.

confirmed.statement: Model judgment within explicit owned contracts remains the governing product direction.
confirmed.strategic_consequence: Preserve doctrine while revising delivery priorities.

confirmed.statement: Root orchestration is an operational baseline and Rust domain owners are useful integration foundations.
confirmed.strategic_consequence: Compare proposed replacements and integrations with demonstrated behavior; compose existing owners.

confirmed.statement: Development can proceed offline with coordinated host/consumer replacement.
confirmed.strategic_consequence: Continuous operation, dual writers and temporary bridges are not default prerequisites.

changed.statement: The external development workflow can supply product operating behavior rather than remain only a bootstrap mechanism.
changed.strategic_consequence: Promote demonstrated properties into a comparison baseline without freezing topology or treating operational success as authority.

changed.statement: The controlled economic comparison is approved but its original launch route is unqualified; there are zero allocated pairs and trial episodes at the recorded qualification result.
changed.strategic_consequence: Resolve the separately owned realized-input/capability boundary prospectively; no efficiency outcome can be inferred.

changed.statement: The lifecycle owner selected a constrained delivery direction after a bounded observation exposed limits of the original evidence route.
changed.strategic_consequence: Consume exact profile qualification separately from the original full-S10 claim; unsupported assurance remains represented.

changed.statement: The canonical strategic route predates substantial current orchestration and Rust integration work.
changed.strategic_consequence: Propose a new near-term route and reconcile workstream evidence after adoption, preserving invariant release outcomes.

priorities.statement: Use demonstrated root behavior as the reference comparison and qualify one supported execution profile.
priorities.strategic_consequence: Put realized capability, startup-input and evidence-producer feasibility before dependent effectful integration.

priorities.statement: Join task/lifecycle, execution, review/evidence and the applicable completion owners for one bounded workflow.
priorities.strategic_consequence: Demonstrate one recoverable owned path rather than create overlapping state authorities.

priorities.statement: Prove supervisor replacement, uncertain-effect recovery and current authority on a task supported by the selected profile.
priorities.strategic_consequence: A retained-snapshot result cannot silently satisfy an engineering-mutation milestone.

priorities.statement: Measure outer-host automation and whole-workflow integration separately, then expand by demonstrated need.
priorities.strategic_consequence: Preserve quality and truthful failures; do not infer general savings or retire release requirements from a bounded pilot.

dependencies.statement: Required capability and evidence premises must be established for the exact admitted claim.
dependencies.strategic_consequence: Unsupported routes return a bounded result or an owner-approved claim change instead of an automatic prerequisite project.

dependencies.statement: Existing independently authorized lanes retain their owners, funding and timing.
dependencies.strategic_consequence: Use lifecycle, native-launch, backend and delivery outcomes without duplicating or redirecting their current assignments.

dependencies.statement: Directly authorized objectives can exercise runtime integration independently of completing every planning consumer.
dependencies.strategic_consequence: Keep idea-to-proposal development and its release requirement; do not impose it as an invented prerequisite for this vertical.

dependencies.statement: Historical disposition and applicable compatibility/live-proof conditions precede the actual operational cutover they govern.
dependencies.strategic_consequence: A fresh development composition does not settle legacy uncertainty or require importing all historical state before its first task.

newly_important.statement: Realized startup inputs and capability restrictions differ from requested sandbox flags.
newly_important.strategic_consequence: Bind actual realization and admissible evidence; static policy checks alone do not establish runtime isolation.

newly_important.statement: Service-owned delivery and context-pressure timeliness have a separately approved implementation lane.
newly_important.strategic_consequence: Reuse its qualified local delivery outcomes; delivery never settles work, transfers authority or mandates context replacement.

newly_important.statement: The integrated consumer needs owner operations and readbacks with truthful unknown states.
newly_important.strategic_consequence: Preserve semantic ownership across cross-store commits and effect reconciliation.

deferred.statement: Additional generalized organizational automation or supervisory layers without a selected workload need.
deferred.strategic_consequence: Retain model-directed formation and minimal runtime bindings for the first vertical; do not assert a universal flat-topology optimum.

deferred.statement: Extension activation without a concrete consuming workload.
deferred.strategic_consequence: Preserve the useful compiler and its existing consumer-based deferral.

deferred.statement: Broad backend interchangeability, general OS observation and unrelated planning/control expansion as default integration prerequisites.
deferred.strategic_consequence: Scope each separately when an actual required consequence or existing authorization justifies it; no accepted product requirement is silently retired.

recommended_campaign.objective: After exact capability feasibility and owner agreement, qualify one root-directed engineering workflow through selected Rust owners with supervisor replacement, uncertain-effect reconciliation, applicable review and complete cost reporting.
recommended_campaign.reason: This is a contingent recommendation for a separately scoped integration assignment, not a launch or an amendment to active campaigns. Its workload and operation profile must match; consume existing lane outcomes first where they are actual prerequisites.

open_uncertainties: The current constrained retained-snapshot profile has no qualification pass established at this cutoff; its broader engineering-mutation suitability is unestablished.
The first supported integration profile may lack a builder or reviewer capability needed by the proposed engineering task.
Cross-owner authority and evidence readbacks need one agreed integration contract; a shared Cargo workspace does not establish their composition.
The current native launch must establish the registered input/tool/network boundary before the economic pilot can allocate treatments.
Local delivery transport, busy-session timing and receiver admission still need their own evidence; Dot turn idempotency is a separate claim.
No causal net cost or time advantage is established for the full converged workflow.
Active status and amendment consequences of every historical campaign reading roadmap.md were not established.
authority_required: Roadmap owner adoption of the proposed strategic route, with the applicable campaign work-source/amendment consequences established before changing roadmap.md.

A named integration owner and an exact new engineering assignment covering workload, supported profile, review, recovery evidence, limits and acceptance. No renewal of already granted independent work is requested.
The affected acceptance owner must authorize any change to a required assurance claim or standalone release outcome; useful narrower evidence cannot waive the original requirement.
Operational publication, live proof, historical-state disposition or cutover retains the authority of its owning contract when selected; none is activated by this handoff.
revisit_when: The selected constrained lifecycle profile reaches a qualified, failed or unsupported terminal result.
The separately owned isolated-launch work establishes or rejects an admissible common route, or a valid matched pilot reports outcomes.
The selected engineering task cannot fit the actually qualified operation profile.
A domain join reveals missing ownership, currentness, evidence or effect reconciliation.
Qualified event delivery changes liveness/timeliness or removes model-managed waiting.
Remaining work, review and recovery no longer fit the actual granted scope, cost or time.
Changed source, claim or authority invalidates evidence used for this recommendation.
